tool.help:
**What it does**
`seqkit stats` computes simple statistics for FASTA or FASTQ files, including number of sequences, total length, minimum/average/maximum sequence length and N50 (with the "all statistics" option).
The output is a tab-delimited table with one row per input file (or per sequence when the "all statistics" option is combined with per-sequence statistics).
**Input**
One or more FASTA or FASTQ datasets (plain or gzipped).
**Output**
A tabular dataset with columns such as:
- `file` - input file name - `format` - detected format (FASTA or FASTQ) - `type` - sequence type (DNA, RNA, Protein or Unknow) - `num_seqs` - number of sequences - `sum_len` - total number of bases/residues - `min_len`, `avg_len`, `max_len` - sequence length statistics
With the "all statistics" option, additional columns are added, e.g. `num_seqs` per type, `N50`, `Q1`, `Q2`, `Q3`, `sum_gap`, `N's` etc.
-----
**References**
- seqkit documentation: https://bioinf.shenwei.me/seqkit/usage/#stats
